verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents durable, long-running tasks with no execution timeout, and waitpoint tokens that pause runs until completed. Survival across deploys and crashes is stated explicitly only for chat.agent tasks. The community wish for wait/resume comes from an older thread and does not concretely contradict the current docs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-day waits, general (non-chat) state persistence across worker/platform restarts, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run long-lived workflows that wait for days and survive worker or platform restarts without losing state

citations.quote: Waitpoint tokens pause task runs until you complete the token.
Durable multi-turn AI chats — one Trigger.dev task per conversation, surviving refreshes, deploys, and crashes.
Tasks are plain async/await functions with no workflow DSL, no determinism rules, and no execution time limit.
